 Wheat flour prices increased
 October 21, 2026 at
 9:02 AM
 Wheat flour companies in Sri Lanka have taken steps to increase the price of wheat flour with immediate effect.
 Accordingly, the price of a kilogram of wheat flour will increase by Rs. 13.
 The revised prices will come into effect immediately. (Newswire)
 2026-10-21
